descriptions.s19_handle_is_one_800a14f4: Appears to return whether the query of the handle at +0x60 yields exactly one.
descriptions.s19_visibility_hide_800a3bb4: Appears to clear the visible flag at +0x1c and notify the visibility helper when it was set.
descriptions.s19_visibility_show_800a3bec: Appears to set the visible flag at +0x1c and notify the visibility helper when it was clear.
descriptions.s19_mode_is_two_800cfc98: Appears to return whether the mode word at +0x2c equals two.
descriptions.s19_vec3_copy_800d0f74: Appears to copy a three-float vector from a 28-byte record array at +0x1c into the destination and return it.
descriptions.s19_set_vec_pair_800dc3dc: Appears to copy two three-float vectors into the fields at +0x60 and +0x54.
descriptions.s19_reset_800b12c8: Appears to clear six integer fields (offsets 4, 8, 16, 20, 24 and 28) and return the object.
